module: WebSocket client backend selector of lua-websockets. Returns an empty table whose __index loads the module 'websocket/client_<name>' on demand for the names 'sync', 'copas', 'ev' and 'new' (alias of 'sync'). Any other name returns nil without loading anything.
usage:
local client = require('libs/lua-websockets/websocket.client')
local ws = client.new({timeout = 1})   -- synchronous backend
local wsCopas = client.copas()         -- copas backend
notes: The loaded backend is cached in the table (client.sync, client.copas...); client.new is the same object as client.sync.
